editionLabel: Fantasy Flight Games English rulebook v2
firstPlayerRule: The player who was most recently underground takes the first player token and goes first.
clarifications: During the Place Dwellers step, players start with the token holder and take turns clockwise until everyone has placed all dwellers or passed.
A room space showing the first-player icon gives its user the token and first turn in the next round.
